name: jotform-bridge/jotform-bridge
description: Development harness for the Jotform Bridge WordPress plugin. Not shipped with the release ZIP.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite. No WordPress, no network.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite against a real WordPress, downloading it first if needed.
scripts-descriptions.wp:install: Download the WordPress the integration suite runs against into .wordpress/.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Check the plugin against phpstan.neon.dist. Types across call boundaries, which phpcs cannot see.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Apply the fixes phpcs can make on its own.
scripts-descriptions.hooks: Regenerate docs/hooks.md from the docblocks in src/.
scripts-descriptions.hooks:check: Fail if docs/hooks.md no longer matches the source.
scripts-descriptions.check: Lint, static analysis, hooks, versions, then the unit suite. The integration suite is a separate command because it downloads WordPress.
